flashcards.front: What are the 4 core principles of GitOps?
flashcards.back:
1. Declarative system description
2. Git as versioned single source of truth
3. Automated software agents to pull state
4. Continuous reconciliation (self-healing)

interviewQuestions.question: What is the difference between Push vs Pull deployment pipelines?
interviewQuestions.modelAnswer: Push pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) execute from outside the cluster and require cluster admin credentials stored on CI runners. Pull pipelines (ArgoCD/Flux) run an agent INSIDE the cluster that continuously monitors Git for changes, pulling and applying them securely without exposing credentials outside.
